Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you make these notes into a self-contained update for our repair cafe, around 200 words, and keep the last bit as an assessment not a wrap-up? this was the May 14 session at North Hall. We had 18 visitors and 6 volunteers, with 11 items brought in: four small electrical things, three garments, two lamps and two bikes. The team fixed a desk lamp with a loose switch and patched one jacket; a toaster was opened up but not repaired because the heating element had failed. One bike needed a part we didn't have, so it went home with its owner unrepaired. The other bike had its brakes adjusted. We also showed two visitors how to sew on a button, but don't count that as a completed repair. We used the new intake cards for every item, and they helped us record owners' contact details and what they'd already tried. The queue was longest just after 11, and two people left before their items were looked at. Please mention that we can only say the intake cards helped with record-keeping at this session, not that they reduced waiting times. End with the assessment: the session handled small fixes and basic guidance well, while repairs requiring unavailable parts or failed components remained out of scope for what we could finish that day. Keep that assessment's conditions and scope, and don't claim every item was repaired.", "output": "Write a self-contained update of around 200 words about the May 14 repair cafe session at North Hall. Use only the details below:

- There were 18 visitors and 6 volunteers.
- Visitors brought 11 items: four small electrical items, three garments, two lamps and two bikes.
- The team fixed a desk lamp with a loose switch and patched a jacket. A toaster was opened but not repaired because its heating element had failed. One bike went home unrepaired because the team lacked a needed part; the other had its brakes adjusted.
- Volunteers showed two visitors how to sew on a button. Do not count this as a completed repair.
- The team used the new intake cards for every item. The cards helped record owners' contact details and what they had already tried.
- The queue was longest just after 11, and two people left before their items were looked at.

End with an assessment, not a general wrap-up. State that the session handled small fixes and basic guidance well, while repairs requiring unavailable parts or failed components remained out of scope for what the team could finish that day. Make clear that the intake cards helped with record-keeping at this session only; do not claim they reduced waiting times. Do not imply that every item was repaired."}]
